assets.name: team-about
assets.prompt: Photorealistic-natural. Wide sophisticated architectural editorial photograph for Casa Nova construction company's about page. Two professional construction specialists in light neutral work clothes and white hard hats, small within a large sunlit commercial office under construction, viewed from behind or in three-quarter view studying a large architectural plan on a waist-height wooden worktable. Broad windows, raw concrete columns, clean organized floor, neatly placed tools in distance. No floor grinding machine, no yellow machine, no logos or lettering. Restrained warm gray ivory walnut palette, soft natural daylight, realistic professional scene, not glossy CGI. Horizontal landscape 3:2, carefully composed with the specialists near right center and generous architectural setting.
